question: The proteins TAP-1 and TAP-2 act in the antigen processing:

options.opa: Transporting peptides from the endosomes to the endoplasmic reticulum.
options.opb: Collaborating with HLA-DM in the cut of the CLIP peptide.
options.opc: Transporting peptides from the cytoplasm to the endoplasmic reticulum.
